contentText: Two Libyan soldiers have died from injuries sustained in an attack, claimed by Ukraine, on Russian ships near Benghazi, a senior figure in the administration in eastern Libya said late on Tuesday. Members of the European Parliament will convene in Strasbourg on Wednesday to discuss "Europe’s role and capacity to protect the international order and secure a just and lasting peace for Ukraine". Follow our liveblog for all the latest updates.
